Spring snapped this morning? That's the most common call we get, and usually a same-day fix. Don't try to force the door open. Pull the opener's red release cord only if the door is fully closed, and call us at (817) 789-2044. Family-owned, open 24/7, serving Watauga and all of DFW.

Facebook / Instagram caption

540+ five-star reviews later, we're still the same small family business. 🧡 Thank you, DFW, for trusting Jose and the Reyes crew with your garage doors. Springs, openers, brand-new doors: call or text (817) 789-2044, any time, day or night. #WataugaTX #FortWorth #GarageDoorRepair #SupportLocal

Website article

Broken garage door spring? What to do in the next 10 minutes 1. Stay clear of the door, and keep kids and pets away. A broken spring means the door is no longer counterbalanced, so it is far heavier than it looks. 2. Don't press the opener button again. The motor can strain or pull the door off track. 3. Don't touch the springs or cables. Torsion springs carry enormous tension. 4. Need your car out? Call first. We'll tell you whether it's safe to open the door by hand. 5. Call Reyes Garage Door at (817) 789-2044. Most spring jobs are done the same day.
